subject: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@stellarcommerce.com>, Priya Singh <priya@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great context on your 2027 roadmap and the personalization use case. Per our discussion, here’s a proposed 4-week POC plan plus the success criteria we’ll use to evaluate fit. Please review and confirm or suggest edits.

POC objective:
- Validate that Redwood’s inference runtime can meet Stellar’s latency, throughput, and quality requirements for the personalization ranking pipeline while operating under your security constraints.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (Nov 8): onboarding, network setup, and dataset ingest (test subset)
- Week 1 (Nov 15): baseline runs + initial evaluation metrics
- Week 2 (Nov 22): tuning (batching/quantization), run expanded workload
- Week 3 (Nov 29): final validation, knowledge transfer, handoff

Success criteria (examples — confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for 512-token context under target concurrency
2) Throughput: sustain 50 requests/sec with acceptable error rates (<1%)
3) Quality: precision >= 92% on the agreed evaluation prompt set (we’ll share the template)
4) Cost proxy: per-request token cost < your internal threshold (we’ll report token-level breakdown)
5) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence shared and network access pattern acceptable to Stellar SecOps

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Redwood (Ethan): setup runtime, run baseline and tuning experiments, provide nightly run logs and eval reports
- Stellar (Alex/Priya): provide sample dataset (PII redacted) and evaluation labels, review nightly reports
- Redwood (Marissa/Rishi): coordinate commercial terms and timelines; Laura to own success metrics and adoption checklist

Next steps (action items):
- Alex/Priya: confirm success criteria and the dataset subset we should use by EOD Tue (Nov 3)
- Stellar SecOps: confirm IP allowlist window and Okta test credentials for SSO
- Redwood: share SOW + evaluation template (attached)

Attachments: POC-SOW-stellar-v1.pdf, evaluation-template.xlsx

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

--
From: Priya Singh <priya@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Thanks Marissa — this looks good overall. A few clarifications from our side before we lock the start date: 

1) Security/Compliance: Our security team requires SOC2 Type II evidence and an IP allowlist for any external test infrastructure. Can Redwood provide a SOC2 report and a recommended IP range for allowlisting?
2) SSO: We plan to use Okta for authentication into any dashboard/test console. We’ll send a test Okta config.
3) Dataset: The initial subset will include customer attributes and event history; we will redact direct PII but may need guidance on safe-sampling.

Given internal approvals and SecOps scheduling, we’d prefer to shift the POC kickoff to Nov 15 instead of Nov 8 unless you can accommodate earlier IP approval.

Action: I’ll loop in our procurement team (procurement@stellarcommerce.com) after we align the SOW.

Best,
Priya Singh
VP, Product
Stellar Commerce
priya@stellarcommerce.com

--
From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@stellarcommerce.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Thanks — quick technical notes / mitigations based on the asks:

- SOC2: we can share our SOC2 report and an architecture diagram that explains data flow. I’ll attach a sample network-config that shows required ports and recommended VPC egress rules (network-config-sample.yaml).
- Okta: we support OIDC/SAML and commonly see cert/clock drift issues during initial testing. When you share the Okta metadata XML we’ll validate cert chain. If there’s a cert mismatch, short-term mitigation is a scoped API key for POC runs while we resolve SSO.
- Data: for PII-sensitive fields we recommend tokenization or hashed identifiers for the POC; we can provide a small redaction script.
- Potential risk: multi-region routing edge case — in prior POCs we observed increased tail latency when cross-region requests hit a misconfigured load balancer. If your SecOps requires testing from IPs in multiple regions, we’ll need to coordinate routing tests and possibly pin to a single region for the POC.

I’ll be available to run through a checklist with your SecOps team.

Attachments: network-config-sample.yaml

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan@redwood.com

--

From: Alex Johnson <alex@stellarcommerce.com>

Cc: procurement@stellarcommerce.com
Date: 2026-11-04T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Quick update from our side after an internal SecOps review: two potential blockers we need help with before we can start:

1) Dataset and PII — our legal team flagged that the sample dataset includes customer-identifiable information. We need a documented redaction approach and a short MPA before any data leaves our environment.
2) Okta SSO — initial tests failed. Our IdP team reports an invalid cert presented by the Redwood test endpoint. We’ll send metadata and a debug trace — this needs an engineer to triage.

Can you confirm an escalation path and an engineer who can own these two items? If we can get a mitigation plan and MPA draft this week, we can keep to the Nov 15 kickoff; otherwise procurement will push the window.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director, Personalization, Stellar Commerce
alex@stellarcommerce.com

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@stellarcommerce.com>, Priya Singh <priya@stellarcommerce.com>, procurement@stellarcommerce.com
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — Stellar Commerce (next steps & escalation)

Hi Alex/Priya — thanks for the call and for flagging the blockers. Below is our proposed mitigation + escalation plan and owners. We’ll treat the Okta cert and MPA as high priority.

Immediate mitigation plan:
- MPA/SOW: Rishi will draft a minimal MPA addendum (data handling for POC) and share a DocuSign link by EOD today (Rishi) — attachment: poc-mpa.pdf (stub).
- Okta SSO triage: Ethan to own triage with Stellar IdP (Ethan). He’ll start with the metadata you send and validate cert chain; if a short-term workaround is acceptable, we can provision a scoped API key for the POC (limited access) while SSO is fixed.
- Data redaction: Laura will provide the redaction checklist and a small script for hashing/redacting PII. She’ll coordinate with your data team on sample transformations.

Escalation contacts (Stellar requested):
- Technical escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (VP Eng, Redwood) — vivek@redwood.com
- Security escalation: Naomi Feldman (Head, Security Ops, Redwood) — naomi@redwood.com

Next steps & owners:
- Alex/Priya: send Okta metadata + a sanitized sample dataset to secure-share@redwood.com by EOD Nov 5
- Ethan: triage Okta cert and report back with mitigation by Nov 6 noon PT
- Rishi: share MPA DocuSign by EOD Nov 5
- Laura: share redaction script and instructions by Nov 6 morning PT

We’ll treat these as blockers for kickoff. If any item cannot be resolved by Nov 8 we’ll move the formal kickoff to Nov 15 as you suggested. Please let me know if this plan works; we’ll add these items to the POC risk tracker and report daily until resolved.

Thanks all —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: poc-mpa.pdf
